summary: Security improvements for the AI assistant connection.

fixes.title: Stronger sign-in for AI assistants
fixes.text: The AI assistant connection uses your sign-in and stays off by default.
fixes.action: If you use the AI assistant connection, re-run its sign-in setup once after the update.

fixes.title: AI assistants find the sign-in
fixes.text: AI assistant clients can now discover how to sign in by themselves.

fixes.title: Ticketing connectors show every field
fixes.text: A connector set up from the live access request description now shows all request fields.
